text: Jie Ye-eun Since 2018, I have covered South Korea’s economic and financial landscape, with experience spanning the economy, banking, financial markets and securities industry. My current beat focuses on Korea’s major chaebol groups and technology industry, including Samsung, SK and LG, as well as global technology companies operating in Korea such as Apple, Google and OpenAI. Key areas of coverage include corporate leadership and strategy, semiconductors, artificial intelligence, devices and consumer electronics, digital platforms and displays. Coverage also extends to the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Korea Fair Trade Commission, the Korea Communications Commission and the Korea AeroSpace Administration, focusing on technology policy and regulation, AI, the semiconductor industry and the broader evolution of Korea’s technology ecosystem.
